titles.romaji: Aisei Tenshi Love Mary: Akusei Jutai THE ANIMATION
titles.english: Sweet Seraph Love Mary ~Unholy Conception~ THE ANIMATION
titles.native: 愛聖天使ラブメアリー ～悪性受胎～ THE ANIMATION

description:
When a magical girl fighting for justice falls into the waiting arms of the concubine of a fallen god...

She fights to protect the people as she is violated with tentacles and manipulated, raped and filled with the seed of demons.
